title: Target bar
description: One horizontal bar to a target: solid segments stacked from the left, coloured by position (needle-700, then categorical-1 and -3), the remaining gap drawn as the track, an optional inset segment lying inside the gap for what is possible but not banked, and a triangle marker on the same scale (games played, last season's level) with a label above.

anatomy.description: The root with data-slot="target-bar", role="img" and the summary; measures its width and draws the SVG at height plus the marker's room.
A visx Bar per segment in a group carrying data-index and data-outlined, with a <title> naming it on hover; siblings step back while one is hovered.
A bark-800 triangle pointing down onto the bar, its label in mono 2xs above, anchored to stay inside the plot.

usage: Segments are a progression, not categories: order them from banked to speculative and mark the speculative one inset.
The scale is [0, target], clamped; a value past the target fills the bar.
The legend is the caller's: a row of Swatch and label pairs using the same position colours (needle-700, categorical-1, categorical-3).
